nodes.characterization_summary: Simulated powder XRD patterns show unique satellite peaks at base of main diffraction peaks characteristic for anisotropic strain gradients in cube, cuboctahedron, and octahedron shaped nanocrystals.
nodes.evidence_snippet: It is demonstrated that the subtle satellite peaks at the base of the main diffraction peaks are different between the shaped nanocrystals. This is characteristic for anisotropic strain gradients (corner/edge compression versus facet expansion) in each shape.

nodes.characterization_summary: CXDI reveals measured compressive/tensile strain distribution in individual β phase Pd nanocube agrees well with 3D phase-field model computation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: By computing from an average of the reconstructions, the measured strain distribution in a β phase nanocube can be obtained (Figure 5g), which agrees well with the strain distribution computed by the phase-field model.

nodes.characterization_summary: Strain maps generated from HRTEM lattice images of cuboctahedral uniform PtFe alloy nanoparticles show lattice contraction relative to bulk Pt is generally quite uniform.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Strain maps were generated from HRTEM lattice images of cuboctahedral uniform PtFe alloys nanoparticles (Figure 7d and 7e) and they found the lattice contraction relative to Pt is generally quite uniform (Figure 7f).

nodes.evidence_snippet: J-PtNW exhibits a well-defined first-neighbor peak at about 2.70Å (Figure 6l), about 2.2 to 2.5% shorter than those predicted for the R-PtNWs (2.76 Å) and the bulk Pt crystal (2.77 Å), which is well confirmed by the EXAFS analysis (Figure 6m).

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM of chemically exfoliated WS₂ shows distorted 1T superlattice phase. Stress tensor map reveals both tensile/compressive stresses with W-W distances 2.7 Å and 3.3 Å vs 3.15 Å for 2H phase (~3% overall lattice parameter change).
nodes.evidence_snippet: HAADF-STEM image (Figure 13a), where the corresponding stress tensor map of such a distorted superlattice is inserted. Both tensile and compressive stresses are seen... W-W atom distances, 2.7Å and 3.3Å... indicate compressive and tensile strain, respectively. The overall change of lattice parameter in the sample is ∼3%.
